caption: The drawing consists of two distinct sections on a beige background. The upper section contains a small, rectangular image of a cloud-like, scalloped shape that is filled with dark grayish-blue and outlined in black; the shape resembles a stylized cloud or a decorative element. Below this, there is a larger rectangular outlined sketch of a lidded jar with handles, drawn in fine black lines. The jar’s body displays the same scalloped shape as in the upper image, rendered in outline only, and above it, the following text is inscribed: “ARNE VLETT 1806 3AMBOY N JERSY.” Near the top left corner of the jar drawing is the number “809.” The composition uses very minimal color, limited to the blue-gray fill in the upper shape, and the rest of the drawing, including the jar outline and inscriptions, is rendered in black line work on a light background.
title: Crock
